lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Noah
lines.text:
The flood spares no one.
 Come aboard, or you'll be washed away.

lines.speaker: player
lines.name: Cat
options: Then I’ll go to a place without floods.
You mean you want a CAT to drift forever?
You don’t have the right to decide my future.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Noah
lines.text: Then let's see if you can cross the flood.
